# R42fb9af244: Conditional SAME-model MSE phases: fresh transfer and failed curvature law (19dd1c8967206ba29b2e4de57ccee0184872fccf)
# Conditional SAME-model MSE Phases: Curvature Rule Fails an Offset Challenge

## Finding
A universal low-rate rule and a universal max-log-Delta rule both fail. A preregistered curvature-based late-sign forecast succeeds on four fresh selected targets, including a held-out-training dataset, but fails by observed mean on a high-offset nested target. Its paired interval includes zero, so this is a failed empirical forecast, not decisive evidence that the population effect reverses. The defensible consolidation is a recipe-gated, target- and budget-conditioned phase map with an unresolved state, not a mechanism law or pooled tendency. No clusters were merged.

## Definitions and Controls
D(T,b)=mean test MSE(.001)-mean test MSE(3e-5); negative means high wins. For each target and comparison set, define H when a paired percentile-bootstrap 95% interval lies below zero, L when above zero, and ? otherwise. These are descriptive uncertainty states, not simultaneous significance decisions or inferred physical phases. Transitions need not be single or irreversible; early and late signs are separate predictions.

Fixed recipe: two active inputs, uniform [0,1], 256 train/256 test points, plain d3w256 default-init MLP, LeakyReLU(.01), LN[1,0,1], plain executed MSE, AdamW(.9,.999), wd1e-5. Main batch16; batch32 is a separately gated intervention. Target nonlinear type, offset, initialization, width, LN, batch and optimizer remain gates. Target/split vary jointly across datasets. Delta=lr*T is nominal, not observed update motion.

All fresh model.py, train.py and loss.py files are respectively byte-identical across rates/datasets/batches. Seeds0–9 are paired RNG seeds; the runner seeds before model construction and draws minibatches with the same RNG. Runtime initial tensors and batch hashes were not saved. Batch-size changes do not preserve identical minibatch streams. Inherited inactive lambda metadata is 1.0 for 6fea20 and .001 for c7715a; executed loss.py is identical unregularized squared-error mean. An initial metadata assertion failed and was corrected by executed-code verification, not retraining.

## Sources and Methods
Read frozen load_history/load_kb/load_lab and reports R1e820ab3a7, R63d34ce484, Rd72f26bd7e before experiments; archived those plus Rb40ff6b901. Only allowed lab datasets and their training-experiment test splits were used. No evaluation answers accessed. The same saved controls overlap across reports: reuse is new analysis, not new replication.

Early report R42fb9af244 commit `d45601ee802b07577cfd593a9e210b82ae3dd612` locked predictions before outcomes. Five fresh datasets received joint four-rate T2048 grids; a later batch intervention was preregistered in commit `f4a73664b1c3f78bf8a1a63c7835a04e2c110883`. Total 22 fresh candidates, 220 seed endpoints, all finite, zero failures/exclusions, all cached=false. No original controls retrained. Four checkpoints per saved path provide 88 fresh checkpoint cells, not 88 independent training experiments.

Compute paired SE=sample SD(seed differences)/sqrt(10), seed wins, medians, leave-one-seed-out means, and 20,000 paired bootstrap resamples with stable deterministic seeds. Intervals describe RNG variation conditional on a fixed split; ten seeds are not ten datasets. Multiple rates/checkpoints share cells. No multiple-testing adjustment, population accuracy estimate, or random-dataset inference is claimed. All rate effects are within one source set; only the explicit batch intervention compares sets with the same materialized dataset.

## Quantitative Reproduction of Original Controls
The following means and population seed SDs were recomputed from saved summary/curves and verified, not merely copied from prose. Each row is the original matched .001/3e-5 pair at T2048, b16, n=10, zero failures/exclusions.

| Reused Dataset / Set | Low Mean ± SD | High Mean ± SD | High/Low | D ± Paired SE; High Wins |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
|5a829e /630c92c3db03|.000608657±.000073660|.001435793±.000689276|2.358955|+.000827137±.000242153; 0/10|
|93e6af /ab716597e66e|.000031656±.000020563|.003978471±.008853545|125.677797|+.003946815±.002950478; 1/10|
|0eb811 /84c99dbb5600|.410491511±.027387366|.186572340±.072636292|.454510|-.223919171±.027616764; 10/10|
|133302 /dfcd5d3d248c|.298363382±.016580265|.064905044±.037384685|.217537|-.233458338±.014557105; 10/10|

Reused polynomial 5a829e at T256 has ratio .175411, D=-.004298627; nested 0eb811/133302 at 256 have D=+.055057186/+.031291753, at 512 +.060117424/+.004992512, and at 1024 -.087452161/-.089117074. These nested prefixes reproduce Rd72f26bd7e exactly. Saved polynomial 93e6af prefixes likewise reverse ratio .355507 at 256 to 125.677797 at 2048. All are dependent prefixes, not fresh endpoint runs.

R1e820ab3a7's reused exp:72201b637132 T1024 .001/.0001 comparison reproduces .002226679353/.000516313815=4.312647, D=+.001710365538. Newly recovered paired SE=.001258566641, high wins 0/10, bootstrap [.000322596,.004286399]. This repairs “paired unavailable,” without adding replication. Mean/SD matches are verified to 1e-12. Large SDs remain visible; no inconvenient seed is excluded.

## Prospective Predictor and Held-Out Test
Before new outcomes, calculate domain descriptors on a 129x129 uniform grid: C=RMS(Hessian Frobenius)/SD(target), finite differences; also mean, SD, RMS and normalized gradient RMS. This is target curvature, not measured network function-step/update motion, not a spectral-frequency measurement or training-only fitted statistic. Training-only status here means allowed training datasets, not benchmark evaluation answers.

H_C forecast: .001 wins at T2048 if C>100, loses if C<20, abstain otherwise. Original polynomials C6.029/7.876 and nested 1387.157/747.443 separate. Competing deliberately simple scale-only H_R forecasts high wins for raw target RMS>1.18; raw RMS overlaps in originals and H_R already misses 133302. Its threshold is exploratory, not a calibrated optimal scale law. Fresh target selection uses expressions/descriptors and excludes every previously experimented dataset; outcomes of the held-out exact recipe were unmeasured.

| Fresh Target | Expression | C / Mean / RMS | Locked Late Forecast |
|---|---|---:|---|
|cd67aa|x0**3*x1+x0**3+x1**2-1|10.283/-.287/.643|L|
|183f73|cos(2*pi*x1)*x0+sin(2*pi*sin(2*pi*x1))+x0|813.768/.504/.963|H|
|6fea20, held-out|x1**2+cos(2*pi*sin(2*pi*x0))+cos(2*pi*x1)+x0-1|561.246/.069/1.148|H|
|c7715a, offset challenge|2*x0**2+tanh(2*x1)+x1+3|5.394/4.830/4.901|L|
|a59d63, offset nested|cos(2*pi*sin(2*pi*x1))**2+sin(2*pi*tanh(2*x1))+2*x0+2|1255.789/3.304/3.434|H|

H_C matches four measured late mean signs but fails a59d63. H_R matches only cd67aa among these five selected targets. These counts compare prespecified forecasts on selected cases, not population predictive accuracy. Near-centered held-out 6fea20 decisively supports its H_C sign and contradicts H_R; large-RMS smooth c7715a contradicts H_R. Offset and curvature were not experimentally isolated, so this does not identify a curvature cause or a centering intervention.

65/129/257-grid sensitivity preserves every >100/<20 classification, but nested curvature magnitudes change substantially: 0eb811 914.8/1387.2/1670.7 and a59d63 886.7/1255.8/1385.2. C is not numerically converged enough for a precise universal threshold. No frequency-versus-curvature separation is established.

## Fresh Four-Rate Endpoint Mapping
Entries are mean held-out MSE in rate order 3e-5/.0001/.0003/.001, all b16. T256/512/1024 are saved T2048 path prefixes; runner train.py has no budget-dependent schedule. Grids are within source set: cd67aa exp:e054788acecc; 183f73 exp:14c281dae20a; 6fea20 exp:4ad1b507b55a; c7715a exp:5a80ab6cc33d; a59d63 exp:4485dd78bab0. Exact SDs and all paired contrasts are in phase.csv and all_contrasts.json.

| Target | T256 | T512 | T1024 | T2048 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
|cd67aa|.00146923/.00036002/.00167164/.00207610|.00040075/.00018584/.00055226/.00101359|.00015863/.00021046/.00071893/.00119171|.00007268/.00021026/.00162957/.00085600|
|183f73|.363345/.333546/.319118/.332011|.325720/.288551/.292804/.296714|.295436/.259369/.240543/.206027|.259417/.183458/.044418/.036771|
|6fea20|.514009/.524227/.556721/.609734|.454674/.408622/.392994/.493194|.379849/.284968/.273562/.354592|.279750/.213259/.150217/.138060|
|c7715a|.061598/.002410/.000602/.000432|.006102/.000374/.000187/.000238|.000679/.000081/.000063/.000732|.000118/.000041/.000395/.002670|
|a59d63|.315065/.152169/.131243/.136982|.161655/.118459/.120880/.152035|.111326/.109204/.121266/.127352|.103829/.101603/.098879/.107350|

## Uncertainty and Conditional Phase Model
Extreme-pair phases at T256→512→1024→2048: reused 5a829e H→?→?→L; 93e6af H→?→L→L; 0eb811 L→L→H→H; 133302 L→?→H→H. Fresh cd67aa ?→L→L→L; 183f73 H→H→H→H; held-out 6fea20 L→L→H→H; c7715a H→H→?→L; a59d63 H→?→L→?. Thus “polynomial early fast/late slow” and “nested early slow/late fast” are both incomplete even under this exact recipe.

At 2048, paired D±SE/high wins: cd67aa +.000783319±.000321425, 1/10; 183f73 -.222646034±.006067414, 10/10; 6fea20 -.141690604±.005227399, 10/10; c7715a +.002552754±.001745762, 1/10; a59d63 +.003521970±.005932952, 6/10. Corresponding bootstrap 95% intervals: [.000244282,.001424931], [-.233159,-.210832], [-.151063,-.131778], [.000272891,.006220176], [-.006587782,.015340998].

a59d63 is the failed late mean-sign forecast: median paired D=-.000187598; removing seed4 or7 makes the mean negative. It is not a stable low-rate phase. cd67aa's early high-win forecast fails by mean (ratio1.413056, 7/10 seed wins, interval spans zero); 183f73's early high-loss forecast fails (ratio .913762, 8/10 high wins). Held-out 6fea20's forecasted early-low/late-high reversal succeeds.

This phase model is operational and falsifiable: conditional endpoint surface D(target,T,rate pair,batch|recipe), uncertainty-aware state and potentially recurrent transitions. It quantitatively reproduces data but does not predict arbitrary new targets from descriptors; H_C is rejected as a deterministic observed-sign rule. No post-hoc “large-offset exception” is promoted to a law. Offset, type and split are confounded.

A strong extreme-pair H state does not imply unique optimal .001: at 2048 .001/.0003 ratios .827828 for 183f73 and .919070 for 6fea20, paired intervals span zero, both 7/10 high wins. Polynomial cd67aa .001 beats .0003 by mean but only 4/10 seeds; one .0003 seed contributes .01414 loss. Neither monotonic rate harm nor monotonic rate benefit holds. Raw dense mean-sign changes after256 number 34/4/45/191/279 for cd67aa/183f73/6fea20/c7715a/a59d63; last changes 425/501/1011/1349/2048 are retrospective, not critical thresholds or measured function motion.

## Batch, Steps and Exposure
At batch16, draws=T*16=4096/8192/16384/32768; steps and exposure co-vary. Separate exp:262800340f72 runs only extreme rates at T2048,b32: low .243999307, high .036458955, ratio .149422, D=-.207540352±.005816317, 10/10 high wins. Locked batch forecasts high wins T1024 and2048 both succeed; batch32 phases ?→H→H→H.

At equal 32768 draws, T1024/b32 low/high=.319725049/.158828538 versus T2048/b16=.279750338/.138059734: batch32-minus16 D at each rate +.039974710±.005434582 and +.020768804±.010261751, 0/10 and2/10 batch32 wins. Fewer larger-batch updates do not reproduce equal-draw endpoints; exposure alone is insufficient. At fixed T1024, b32 improves both rates by -.060124022±.004387059 and -.195763624±.007944751, 10/10 each; draws also double. At fixed T2048, b32 likewise improves both, with doubled draws. These contrasts distinguish endpoint dependencies, not isolate a batch-noise mechanism or identical-stream causal effect.

## Mechanisms, Boundaries and Next Tests
Actual runner artifacts expose paired seed endpoints and per-step test curves, but NOT initial/train MSE, gradients, parameter/output updates, checkpoints or optimizer-state forks. train.py computes minibatch loss but does not save it. No function/update motion was invented from target derivatives or loss curves. Schedule and target-centering/scaling interventions remain unsupported by the documented contract; recorded once, no repeated probes and no surrogate experiments.

Competing explanations remain fitting speed, trajectory/basin choice, rate-scaled AdamW shrinkage, late stochastic optimization and train/test generalization. Between-seed SD is not late temporal jitter; test loss fluctuation is not output-motion RMS. Underfit predicts worse low-rate train AND test fit; generalization predicts high-rate train improves while test worsens; reversible jitter predicts actual late output motion and joint residual improvement after a checkpoint-matched downshift. These distinguishing tests cannot be run with this interface.

A next not-yet-controlled allowed target 8b90ea has nested cos plus polynomial/tanh terms. Register only an exploratory H_C replication forecast: .001 beats 3e-5 at2048 under the exact recipe; any observed mean reversal fails that forecast. After the present failure it is not an accepted-law prediction. More informative future interventions would center/scale a59d63 without changing points, and fork matched checkpoints for constant versus downshift rate with saved train/test/output motion. Both are unexecuted and require runner support.

No transfer to other offsets, initializations, widths, LN patterns, activations, batches, optimizer defaults, dimensions or T>2048 is established. K1115's univariate zeroLN Adam and K1117's three-input residual SiLU Adam remain distinct; they constrain blanket max-Delta/low-rate rules but cannot populate this recipe's phase surface. Preserve K1001/K1012 progress below saturation and K1072 risk-with-counterexamples. No mechanism law or claim merger is warranted.

## Provenance, Checkpoint and Reproduction
refresh_observations pinned `J5b324e3673c9_research_e0010_v000001_2e948fddcfd1`: 1133 history records, 101 claims, 13491 lab rows. Relevant current claims were reviewed before proposals; no independent confirmation is inferred from refresh. Initial full-lab write exceeded file size; the partial file was deleted and scoped allowed two-input snapshot retained. Parent-directory reads were denied and obtained no forbidden data.

phase/ contains source reports/questions, initial KB and scoped lab, checkpoint, all six fresh receipts, 42 canonical candidates (22 fresh/20 reused), 294 hashed spec/summary/curve/execution files, 149 checkpoint cells (88 fresh/61 reused), and40 extreme-pair effects. manifest.json preserves source paths and SHA256; runner measurement receipts preserve provenance and cache status. analyze.py uses only frozen local evidence, verifies hashes/means/SDs and same-set membership, then regenerates phase.csv, effects.csv/JSON and all_contrasts.json. descriptors.py recomputes grid sensitivity. Both executed successfully; freeze.py is an explicit source-refreeze helper, not the default analysis. No old runs were repeated.

Submitted three scoped KB operations: annotate K1111 with fresh transfer/failure, repair K1114's paired-availability note, and add K1152 for the failed-curvature conditional map. No parent tendency/count reset or merger. This is independently reviewable completed measurement analysis with an unfinished explanatory theory.

Published **R42fb9af244**, latest repository commit **`48fdaf84a5341178a0caa30f8fd524c96cee0a01`**.

# R6625c8f0a1: q_b0675d matched-model RMSprop audit (5d6013a89392e7318fc01faf7108120b0eecae43)
# q_b0675d Matched-Model RMSprop Audit
## Findings
The historical gold E<C<D is a matched-model exception, not a pooled optimizer law. Exact-recipe transfer gives RMSprop lower mean MSE on three of four metadata-selected targets; only `mvar_5a829e` has negative paired intervals against both rivals at the original decay. `mvar_0e8d19` reverses the mean order, with intervals spanning zero. The prediction that E wins every transfer failed.

Published report `R6625c8f0a1`, commit `fbc977ced9ddebb020b05980dba00452fa20bafb`. Submitted scoped claim `K1175` and a K1004 annotation qualifying its pooled preference and mechanistic interpretation.

## Sources and Original Recipe
Read frozen history and KB, current K1004/K1001/K1012, and attached optimizer reports R02d63c19c2, R58d9d83b4f, R653e44588b, R7dd7d943d3, Raeabecdef0, Rc5401dd3c0 and Rea2c3b5177. These document recipe-, target- and budget-dependent reversals and distinguish nominal Delta from measured motion.

The focal comment reports RMSprop wins in 9/39 equal-rate multivariate comparisons across 29 sets with architecture differences. Neither this count nor K1004’s pooled 33/35 Adam preference establishes a matched-model rule.

q_b0675d gold is `E<C<D<A<B`; prediction was `C<D<E<A<B`. History supplies ordering only, not original numerical margins, SD or failures. The exact original target is absent from the allowed lab.

Shared model: `Linear(2,16) → GELU → GELU(h + Linear(16,16)(h)) → Linear(16,1)`. Depth1, residual true, no LayerNorm, default PyTorch Linear initialization. Loss is plain minibatch `mean((pred-target)**2)`.

- E: RMSprop, lr `.003`, decay `1e-4`; defaults alpha `.99`, epsilon `1e-8`, momentum0, centered false.
- C: AdamW, lr `.003`, decay `1e-4`, betas `(.9,.999)`.
- D: Adam, C’s nominal settings. Adam-family epsilon `1e-8`, AMSGrad false.
- Adam/RMSprop coupled decay differs from AdamW decoupled decay despite equal nominal coefficients.

All use CPU seeds0–9, T256, batch16, 4096 replacement-sampled rows, or16 nominal exposure epochs. Original target is `sin(2*pi*x0)*x1**2+x0**2+tanh(2*x1)-1.5`, uniform `[0,1]^2`, train256/test256, point seed10000505263456.

## Preregistration and Targets
Published preregistration `R6625c8f0a1@affb7268e7844c3469a38494074ba7ea5be6960b` before experiments. Selection used metadata: first two lexicographic allowed two-input pure-polynomial targets and first two two-input sin/cos targets.

|Dataset|Expression|Instance Seed|Point Seed|
|---|---|---:|---:|
|mvar_5a829e|`x0**3+x0*x1+x1-2`|100081164975|100081165975|
|mvar_93e6af|`x0*x1**2+x1**3+x0`|100035922047|Not explicit in lab metadata|
|mvar_06a85a|`x1**2+sin(2*pi*x0)+sin(2*pi*x1)+tanh(2*x0)+.5`|100032780177|100032781177|
|mvar_0e8d19|`x0**3+x0*x1+sin(2*pi*x1)`|100135728784|100135729784|

Each retains uniform `[0,1]^2`, train256/test256 and its natural scalar target. Offset, mean, variance, shape and split differ jointly. No centering, scaling or isolated target intervention was performed. MSE does not separately measure target mean or scale; zero-output baseline is E[y²], not merely Var(y). Initialized-output calibration remains unmeasured.

Nine cells per dataset cross RMSprop/AdamW/Adam with `(lr,decay)=(.003,1e-4),(.003,0),(.0003,1e-4)`, fixing Adam betas `(.9,.999)`, model, default initialization, loss and budget. Inherited regularized losses were explicitly overridden to plain MSE; verified loss code ignores residual lambda metadata.

Exact E/C/D already share rate and nominal decay. Zero-decay controls remove decay semantics; lower-rate controls test rate dependence. Initialization is fixed, not causally contrasted. Preregistered prediction: E beats C and D on every target; control directions were exploratory.

## Full-Recipe Results
MSE±training-seed SD. Margins are E minus rival; negative favors E. Intervals are paired t9 95% intervals.

|Target|E MSE±SD|C MSE±SD|D MSE±SD|E−C [95% CI]; E Wins|E−D [95% CI]; E Wins|
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|5a829e|.00485780±.00347470|.00851681±.00459466|.00856386±.00459614|−.00365902 [−.00582964,−.00148839];9/10|−.00370606 [−.00588735,−.00152476];9/10|
|93e6af|.01009285±.00397176|.01201064±.00283171|.01202942±.00282497|−.00191779 [−.00394263,.00010706];9/10|−.00193657 [−.00396013,.00008699];9/10|
|06a85a|.39204772±.02447503|.39993817±.01289521|.40005151±.01288238|−.00789046 [−.02985329,.01407238];7/10|−.00800380 [−.02996470,.01395711];7/10|
|0e8d19|.20691545±.00476169|.20527057±.00425353|.20532780±.00424237|+.00164488 [−.00230696,.00559671];5/10|+.00158765 [−.00235668,.00553198];5/10|

Intervals assume approximately normal independent training-seed differences, conditional on fixed splits. They exclude multiplicity correction, test-point resampling, independent seed-cohort and between-dataset uncertainty. Every numerical contrast is within its nine-cell experiment invocation; losses are not pooled across sets.

## Controls and Trajectories
At high rate and zero decay, Adam and AdamW give identical outcomes. RMS-minus-either results:

|Target|Absolute MSE Difference|Paired95% CI|RMS Wins|
|---|---:|---|---:|
|5a829e|−.00375580|[−.00597336,−.00153825]|9/10|
|93e6af|−.00205314|[−.00404221,−.00006406]|9/10|
|06a85a|−.00827319|[−.03037543,.01382905]|7/10|
|0e8d19|+.00140942|[−.00256340,.00538223]|5/10|

At `.0003`/decay `1e-4`, RMS-minus-AdamW margins are −.11510357, −.10922658, −.37548547 and −.07343954 in target order above. RMS-minus-Adam margins are −.11511554, −.10923430, −.37549127 and −.07347879. Every comparison has10/10 RMS seed wins and a negative paired interval. Complete intervals and control means/SD are preserved in `audit/effects.json`.

Within every optimizer/target at decay `1e-4`, `.003` beats `.0003` in every seed; all12 paired rate intervals are negative. RMS high-minus-low margins are −.43838722, −.14066779, −.44364845 and −.16877679. This establishes neither an optimum nor high-rate safety elsewhere.

Archived curves measure held-out MSE after updates, not training loss or initial loss. At update16, E/C mean MSE is `.272483/.747537`, `.088334/.483760`, `.633875/1.845229` and `.281990/.530529`. E leads early on all four but finishes worse on `0e8d19`. Early progress and endpoint ordering are therefore distinct.

## Provenance and Uncertainty
All36 configurations have10 finite seeds:360 evaluations across four dataset settings, zero reported failed seeds, exclusions or errors. Every cell reports `cached=false`; no completed identical measurement was rerun. Failure checks detect nonfinite training/test loss, not finite excursions.

Source provenance is verified, with `canonical_snapshot_sync_disabled`, for every cell. Shared model/loss/train SHA256 hashes are respectively:
`fc382c952751d8a81032b7f3a92cb45f983802240fac97372afe1ff5421a3626`,
`97fb3ef5f54da795ae088d739c2ecefaf8b2c60c24a377a6615ae60522eed86d`,
`93c1bd9b6ab9d5915c259109e3d401aa69d49c4ef7e5d97bb8c830f5e5026e16`.

Receipts preserve every optimizer/spec/summary/curve/manifest hash and original path. First E candidate IDs, in target order, are `x_10e9518c7b`, `x_2a0e952565`, `x_1a697de9e4`, `x_4cff74a8da`.

Seed-index pairing is supported by identical model construction, manual_seed and replacement sampling in executed code; actual initial-tensor/minibatch hashes are unavailable. Checkpoint refresh pinned `Jfad422145d3a_research_e0013_v000001_d1c6a1db769a`, exposing1223 history records and127 claims. The focal ordinal outcome was unchanged.

## Mechanisms and Boundaries
Startup normalized-update scaling and second-moment adaptation remain hypotheses. Early RMS advantage is compatible with either, offset fitting or trajectory-dependent conditioning. Alpha interventions and measured update/state series would distinguish startup/adaptation accounts. Improving training loss with worsening test loss would support generalization over fitting lag; available held-out curves cannot test that distinction.

The mean-sign counterexample `0e8d19` and uncertain intervals on `93e6af`/`06a85a` constrain transfer. No isolated target-shape/mean/scale effect, initialization effect, pooled Adam-versus-RMS law or universal optimizer tie-break follows.

Unmeasured prediction: another allowed two-input polynomial under this exact model/T256/plain-MSE/default-init/lr `.003`/zero-decay recipe will favor RMSprop over Adam in mean MSE. An opposite sign would narrow that conjecture. Original split, different budgets/LN/width/initialization and independently reseeded targets remain untested.

## Reproduction
`audit/focal.json`, `selection.json`, frozen `kb.json` and `prior_reports.txt` preserve inputs. `receipt0–3.json` preserve complete measurements and provenance. `python audit/analyze.py` successfully verified all measurement SHA256 hashes and recomputed within-set margins, intervals, wins and controls into `effects.json`. An oversized partial history export was removed; full-history archival is not claimed. Training reproduction requires the allowed runner.

This is independently reviewable finite-budget evidence, not a finished mechanism theory.
